request: Build me a rental contracts module: each contract has a contract number, a customer, a start date and an end date, with contract lines for the equipment and its daily rate, and statuses Quote, Reserved, On rent and Closed.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Rental contract" with 4 fields:
  - State (one of "Quote", "Reserved", "On rent", "Closed", required)
  - Contract number (text, required)
  - Start date (date, required)
  - End date (date, required)
  Each record belongs to one company.
  It gets its own menu entry "Rental contract" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Rental contract records.
New line table "Contract lines" on Rental contract:
  - Line number (whole number, required)
  - Equipment (text, required)
  - Daily rate (whole number, required)
  Each record belongs to one company.
New required link "Customer" from Rental contract to Party. Choose it when creating a record.
New lifecycle for Rental contract. Records start at "Quote".
  - Reserve changes "Quote" to "Reserved" after confirmation.
  - Start rental changes "Reserved" to "On rent" after confirmation.
  - Close contract changes "On rent" to "Closed" after confirmation.

Stored data: 2 new tables, 2 addForeignKey x2, 4 new indexes. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
